card.title: Regional Director of Operations
card.description:
At El Pollo Loco, we are on a mission to be the nation’s leading fire-grilled chicken restaurant. When it comes to our people, we are all about growth. Whether that means specialized training, a clearly laid out career trajectory or collaborating cross-functionally, we are committed to the success of our people the same way we’ve been committed to the success of the El Pollo Loco brand for the last 50 years. In fact, we see you as our secret ingredient. While our chicken is fire, it’s our people who set us ablaze.
 
 
Our restaurants are only the tip of the flame! If you’re looking for an innovative, winning, and welcoming workplace, then a flamin’ good career in our Restaurant Support Center is right for you.
 
 
At our Support Center, we believe our best work is done Together, when departments collaborate and everyone is confident in contributing their ideas. This is why we are in the office 3 days per week.
 
 
Let’s Get Loco!
 
 
What’s in it for you!
 
 

* STRONG office culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® and driven by our core values: Simple. Together. Relentless. Ownership. Nimble. Growth
* Career growth opportunities
* Competitive pay and bonus potential
* Be an Owner: Equity Compensation
* Medical + Dental + Vision Insurance + HSA Savings Account
* 401(K) Retirement Plan with company match and immediate vesting
* Paid Vacation + Sick Pay + 12 Paid Holidays
* Employee Assistance Program
* Free El Pollo Loco food + restaurant discounts
* PerkSpot discounts program

**POSITION PURPOSE:** 
The Regional Director of Operations is responsible for driving El Pollo Loco’s success in the Los Angeles, CA region. They are responsible for providing operational expertise, strategic leadership and coaching. Directs, leads, manages and analyzes all aspects of the restaurant operations for the Areas under their direction to ensure achievement and maintenance of the regional sales, budgetary targets, controllable profit, performance metrics (e.g., service, quality, cleanliness, etc.), brand integrity, and compliance standards (e.g., food and restaurant safety, federal/state/local labor laws, etc.). Implements and executes strategic and tactical operational initiatives that support future business growth strategies. Oversees and manages adequate resource availability for existing and new restaurant openings including the attraction, retention, training, development and coaching of a high performing management team.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 

* Oversees all aspects of the region’s restaurant business, operations, and facilities. Directs and aligns company strategies with restaurant management activities.
* Utilizes reporting systems to determine trends in sales, cost of goods and guest services. Reviews, monitors and manages the financial progress of the individual restaurants and region, including food and labor costs, ensuring budgeted targets are achieved.
* Meets regularly with Area Leaders to coach, develop, train and review performance, share best practices and disseminate information on any areas where there is an opportunity for improvement (e.g., P&L, RCP, FSA, QSC, Mystery Shops, etc.). Develops action plans with Area Leaders to improve revenue, profitability and quality/service standards.
* Directs, manages and ensures the region’s successful and timely implementation of all marketing strategies and LTOs. Supports and inspects marketing strategies in building guest counts and sales.
* Provides effective and timely resolution to all guest and employee complaints, conflicts and employee relations that cannot be resolved at the Area Leader level.
* Ensures the region’s restaurants are in compliance with all local, regional, and national laws and have all the required documentation and paperwork.
* Leverages two-way communication with Field and Support Center employees. Represents the Operations perspective on prioritization, planning and promotions to inspire operational excellence, effective implementation and facilitate insights. Provides specific operational input and feedback into the development of new products and programs to ensure successful execution.
* Collaborates with Development, Human Resources, and Operations in the coordination and execution of new restaurant openings. Directs team selection, monitors the training and ensures the teams perform to El Pollo Loco’s standards. Participates in the local public relations support in all locations. Approves employee relocation within region ensuring moves are conducted in the most economical and efficient manner.
* Develops regional succession plans: evaluates open opportunities, assesses internal talent, oversees management training programs, and drives recruiting efforts to ensure adequate number of managers are available to sustain growth of the organization.
* Champions effective vertical and horizontal communications within the regional area including Company-wide news of interest, upcoming events, new facilities, promotions, product developments, “Best Practices” among peers, etc. Prepares thoroughly and delivers well-organized, dynamic and informative presentations to senior management as needed. Holds meetings with their respective teams on a regular basis to ensure fluid and consistent messaging.
* Creates and fosters a positive team environment through recognizing and reinforcing behaviors and results that are aligned with El Pollo Loco’s core values and culture. Ensures open channels for employee suggestions.
* Interacts professionally and ethically, constructively participating as a collaborative team leader in pursuit of common goals, including active attendance to meetings. Initiates cost-effective suggestions to improve operational procedures.
* Other activities, duties or responsibilities that are assigned by your supervisor.

QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:
 
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. The requirements listed below are representative of the education and/or experience required.
 
 
**Education/Work Experience:** 
High school diploma or equivalent (GED) required, BA/BS degree in Business Administration preferred. 8+ years QSR/multi-site restaurant experience as an Area Leader or District Manager required; 5+ years regional QSR management experience preferred; 3+ years El Pollo Loco experience preferred; and a track record of success in leading, managing, coaching and developing high performance teams.
 
 
**License/Certifications:** 
Current valid driver’s license required as frequent weekly travel is involved. Current ServSafe certification preferred.
 
 
**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** 

* Experience with successfully recruiting, building, and developing a team (based on current and future needs).
* Confidence in execution of strategic initiatives.
* Must be decisive and able to make fact-based decisions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset and skills; meticulous attention to detail
* Ability to effectively communicate with internal and external business partners.
* Ability to prioritize and plan work assignments and work under pressure of frequent and tight deadlines.
* Ability to read, write, and interpret complex reports, documents, and correspondence.
* Adept at managing and prioritizing competing time sensitive requests while working well in a team atmosphere that may be under pressure.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment on matters of significance to the company.
* Ability to work weekends and extended work schedules as needed.
* Must be willing and able to travel locally within Southern California and to out-of-state restaurant locations, as needed by car or airplane.

Our Company
 
 
In 1980 the first American El Pollo Loco opened on Alvarado Street in Los Angeles, quickly becoming a destination for the best citrus-marinated, fire-grilled pollo in town. Over the past four decades, El Pollo Loco has grown into more than 500 restaurants across 9 states, becoming an L.A. mainstay and cultural benchmark along the way. And today, we continue to work just as hard to always provide customers with fresh and innovative L.A. Mex from our famous family dinners to Mexican entrees.
 
 
The pay range identified is the hourly or salary rate El Pollo Loco expects to pay for the posted position. This range does not include any benefits or bonus opportunities that might be available for the position based on position and eligibility criteria. Individual pay will vary based on a variety of factors including years of experience, industry experience, education, geography, etc.

-----------------------

* BS or MBA in operations management, engineering, or dairy and/or food science preferred.

* Demonstrated leadership ability with strong interpersonal skills and a proven ability to build, develop, and motivate high-performing teams.
* Minimum eight years of experience required, with at least five years of production/operations management experience.
* Experience within dairy industry or food processing highly preferred.

* Lead the development and implementation of operational strategies, policies, and processes to drive efficiency and organizational effectiveness within manufacturing operations.
* Lead and oversee all aspects of employee management for the operations, quality, and process engineering departments, including recruiting, hiring, training, work assignment, performance management, employee development, recognition, and discipline. Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.

card.description:
**Sr Director or Assistant Vice President, Fundraising Operations**

Department: Lawrence Development

Reports to: Vice President, Development

FLSA Status: Exempt

The anticipated salary for this position starts at $124,100+ for the Sr. Director role and ranges up to $150,200+ for the Assistant Vice President role. The final pay will be determined based on several factors, including qualifications, experience, education, and years within the job or industry, with a strong emphasis on maintaining internal equity.

**Who we are and what we’re about:**

KU Endowment is an independent, nonprofit organization and the official fundraising foundation for the University of Kansas. We partner with donors in providing philanthropic support to build a greater KU.

As an employee of KU Endowment, you’ll witness firsthand the power of our donors’ generosity. You will join a talented and fun group of people who are inspired to help KU through the support of loyal alumni and friends. This support fuels excellence, enabling students and faculty to develop innovative programs and research that distinguish the university. We connect the philanthropic passions of donors with the needs of students, faculty and programs – and everyone benefits.

People are engaged. Purpose is ignited. Lives are changed.

**What we are looking for:**

The Senior Director/AVP, Fundraising Operations is the strategic operating leader responsible for translating advancement strategy into measurable fundraising performance. The role establishes the planning, analytics, management cadence, pipeline discipline, portfolio practices, and decision support that help fundraising leaders focus resources, improve execution, and achieve fundraising goals.

Serving as a trusted partner to executive leadership and frontline fundraising leaders, this role connects fundraising strategy, people, processes, data, and technology into a coherent revenue operating system. It provides visibility into performance, identifies risks and opportunities, and drives continuous improvement while enabling fundraisers and managers to spend more time building donor relationships and generating support.

The individual in this position is expected to embrace KU Endowment’s stated core values – collaboration, curiosity, empowerment, and excellence – and demonstrate support for them through professional interactions and activities.?

**What’s a typical day look like?**

* Build, lead, and evolve a high-performing fundraising operations function, including supervising, coaching, and developing development analysts, while establishing priorities, service standards, team capabilities, and scalable practices that support organizational growth and increasing complexity.
* Lead fundraising planning and operations strategy by translating institutional and campaign priorities into fundraising plans, goals, performance measures, resource allocation strategies, forecasting processes, and operational priorities.
* Direct fundraising forecasting, pipeline management, and feasibility assessment processes to improve revenue predictability, solicitation readiness, and achievement of fundraising objectives.
* Develop and implement portfolio management, prospect assignment, capacity planning, and fundraiser productivity frameworks that maximize donor coverage, fundraiser capacity, and fundraising performance.
* Provide executive leadership with analytics, forecasting, scenario modeling, and decision support that identify trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
* Design and facilitate management cadences, strategic reviews, and performance accountability processes that drive execution, continuous improvement, and goal attainment.
* Serve as the strategic business leader for fundraising operations technology, including CRM, reporting, analytics, and related platforms, ensuring systems, processes, and data support effective decision-making and fundraising outcomes.
* Lead organizational adoption of new Development focused processes, technologies, performance measures, and operating practices through effective change management, communication, training, and stakeholder engagement.
* Foster strong partnerships with fundraising leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to align strategy, data, technology, and operations in support of fundraising success.
* Regular and reliable attendance is essential for this position.
* Performs other duties as may be assigned.

**What’s required to be considered:**

* Bachelor’s degree required. Preference for a degree in business, finance, analytics, information systems, nonprofit management, higher education administration, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or equivalent advanced experience preferred.
* Management experience required. Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and managing or developing analytical/operations teams preferred.
* Typically 5–8+ years of progressively responsible experience in fundraising operations, advancement services, revenue operations, sales operations, analytics, business planning, or a related discipline.
* Experience in higher education, healthcare, nonprofit fundraising, or another complex relationship-driven organization preferred.
* Experience supporting campaign planning, enterprise fundraising goals, or large, distributed fundraising teams preferred.
* Experience with Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud or Salesforce fundraising implementations, data/BI platforms, and marketing or engagement technology preferred.

Senior Director, Fundraising Operations

A Senior Director demonstrates the ability and experience necessary to lead and optimize KU Endowment’s Fundraising Operations function, translating strategy into execution through planning, analytics, technology, forecasting, and team leadership.

* Typically 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in fundraising operations, advancement services, revenue operations, sales operations, analytics, business planning, strategy, or a related field.
* Demonstrated success leading an operations, analytics, advancement services, or revenue operations function and supervising professional staff.
* Experience developing and implementing forecasting, portfolio management, performance management, reporting, technology, or operational planning processes.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence decision-making through analytics, insights, and operational recommendations.
* Capable of building, managing, and continuously improving a high-performing fundraising operations function.

Assistant Vice President, Fundraising Operations

An Assistant Vice President demonstrates the ability and experience necessary to lead KU Endowment’s Fundraising Operations function while serving as an enterprise-level strategic advisor, influencing fundraising strategy, organizational effectiveness, resource allocation, and transformational change initiatives across the organization.

* Typically 8+ years of progressively responsible experience in fundraising operations, advancement services, revenue operations, sales operations, analytics, business planning, strategy, or a related field.
* Demonstrated success leading complex operations, planning, analytics, advancement services, or revenue operations functions with organization-wide impact.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise operating models, performance frameworks, resource allocation strategies, forecasting methodologies, or technology roadmaps across multiple teams or business units.
* Proven track record serving as a strategic advisor to executive leadership and leading significant organizational change and transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to influence organizational strategy and drive outcomes through leadership of cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and senior leaders, regardless of direct reporting relationships.

**What separates the best from the rest?**

* Exceptional strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex fundraising data, trends, and business needs into actionable recommendations and operational priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to develop performance frameworks, forecasting models, and management practices that improve fundraising effectiveness, accountability, and goal attainment.
* Deep understanding of fundraising operations, including campaign planning, pipeline management, portfolio strategy, prospect development, forecasting, performance management, and revenue planning.
* Ability to evaluate fundraising opportunities, project feasibility, philanthropic readiness, organizational capacity, and associated risks to support data-informed decision-making and resource investment.
* Strong data literacy and business intelligence skills, including the ability to leverage CRM platforms, reporting tools, analytics, and emerging technologies to inform strategy and improve organizational performance.
* Ability to lead technology-enabled change, drive adoption of new processes and systems, and continuously improve operational effectiveness across a complex organization.
* Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with executive leaders, managers, frontline fundraisers, and cross-functional partners.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, build consensus among diverse stakeholders, and foster collaboration across teams and functions.
* Proven success leading, developing, and coaching high-performing teams while creating a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, innovation, and service excellence.
* Ability to establish and maintain professional and effective working relationships inside and outside KU Endowment.
* Ability to adapt to new procedures and technology.

**Physical Requirements:**

* A valid driver’s license.
* Must have access to reliable transportation to travel between multiple locations for training, donor meetings, networking, events and/or work-related activities.
* Must be able to respond quickly and effectively to directions and safety hazards.
* This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office productivity machinery such as computers, keyboards and a mouse, laptops, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.
* This is largely a sedentary role; however, some filing is required. This would require the ability to move files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand as necessary.
* The ability to observe details at close range (within a few feet of the observer).
* The person in this position frequently communicates with donors, colleagues, students, and general public. Must be able to communicate with others effectively.
* Physical effort/lifting is limited – up to 40 pounds.
* Travel requirements are rare and can include the following, evenings, weekends, and out of town overnights as a regular part of the job.

KU Endowment is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals to enable them to perform the essential functions of the job as regulated by ADA. If you require accommodation for any part of the application process or during employment, please contact humanresources@kuendowment.org to discuss your needs.

**We’ve got you covered:**

KU Endowment offers a competitive salary with an excellent benefit package including:

* 100% employer-paid pension plan
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) and Roth 401(k) matching program
* Section 125 flexible benefits
* Generous paid leave including holidays, personal and sick leave
* Volunteer and community engagement opportunities
* Paid Parental Leave
* Life, AD&D, short- and long-term disability insurance
* Legal & ID Theft protection
* Critical Illness
* Accident and Hospital Indemnity insurance
* KU education assistance
* Free parking

**Sounds good, right? What’s next?**

Please include your resume and cover letter when applying for this position on our website at https://www.kuendowment.org/careers.

Questions regarding this vacancy may be addressed to:

Human Resources

KU Endowment

PO Box 928

Lawrence, KS 66044-0928

Email: HumanResources@KUEndowment.org

Review of applications begins immediately and continues until the position is filled. Because of the sensitive nature of KU Endowment business and the importance of our reputation with donors, KU Endowment conducts a comprehensive review of applicants. By submitting your application, you authorize us to conduct reference checks and a review of available public information. Employment is contingent upon background and reference checks that KU Endowment finds acceptable.

card.description:
Description:

Happy Corner Hospitality is the group behind Motek, Yalla Motek and Sesame Bakery. Since opening our first Motek in Downtown Miami in 2020, we've grown to 14 locations across South Florida and New York. Our Mediterranean menu draws on family roots in Lebanon, Morocco, Turkey, Yemen and beyond. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional service and culinary experiences to our valued guests. As we continue to grow, we're seeking passionate, experienced individuals to join our group!

**Position Summary:**

As Operations Director, you will lead the overall performance of your assigned restaurants, guiding General Managers and their teams to deliver consistent, exceptional guest experiences across front and back of house. You will drive operational excellence, uphold brand standards and own the financial results of your locations, while developing strong leaders and a positive, high-performing culture. This role requires proven multi-unit leadership, sharp business judgment and a genuine passion for hospitality.

**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

*Operations & Guest Experience* 

* Oversee day-to-day operations across assigned locations, ensuring consistent front- and back-of-house performance
* Uphold brand standards and service at the highest quality across every location
* Conduct regular restaurant visits and operational audits, and follow up on action plans
* Ensure all corporate mandates, policies and daily reporting are completed and tracked
* Partner with the Culinary team to maintain food quality, consistency and kitchen standards
* Ensure all locations are clean, safe and well maintained, with equipment and repairs handled promptly
* Support new restaurant openings, including hiring, training and pre-opening readiness

*People & Leadership* 

* Lead, coach and develop General Managers and management teams
* Set clear goals and expectations, and hold leaders accountable for results
* Partner with HR on recruiting, hiring and staffing plans for management and key roles
* Identify and develop high-potential team members for growth into leadership roles
* Drive team morale, engagement, productivity and retention
* Enforce company standards, policies and expectations consistently across locations

*Financial Performance* 

* Own budgeted revenue, cost of sales (COS), labor, supplies and operating cash flow (OCF) for assigned locations
* Review monthly profit and loss statements with General Managers and drive action plans on variances
* Monitor operational expenses and identify opportunities to improve profitability
* Set and track sales forecasts and profitability goals
* Drive sales growth through marketing initiatives, community engagement and team incentives
* Keep C-suite leadership informed of performance, trends and key operational issues

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Wages paid weekly
* Growth opportunity
* 401(k) savings plan
* Paid time off
* Medical, dental and vision insurance
* Employee discounts

Requirements:

* 5+ years of leadership experience managing high-volume, fast-paced front-of-house restaurant operations
* Degree in hospitality or business preferred, or equivalent professional experience
* Strong knowledge of service standards, guest experience and regulatory compliance
* Experience managing budgets, labor, inventory and operating costs
* Ability to plan staffing, scheduling and team productivity
* Strong organization, multitasking and attention to detail
* Effective communicator with a collaborative, team-oriented leadership style
* Experience with marketing, sales initiatives and strategies to increase revenue is a plus
* Bilingual proficiency is a plus

Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

As part of our expanding Medical Affairs organization, we seek a dynamic and experienced Director, Stakeholder Engagement Strategy & Operations to support the strategy, planning, and execution of global medical congress activitiesand elevate Revolution Medicines’ presence at major scientific congresses as our portfolio and organization grow. This individual will report to the Head of Scientific Stakeholder Engagement within Global Medical Excellence and will partner cross-functionally with Commercial, Clinical Development, and Research, providing leadership for global congress activities to ensure seamless integration of congress objectives with broader organizational priorities. Key responsibilities will include:

Congress Strategy & Execution

* Develop congress strategy for Medical Affairs with a focus on oncology therapeutic areas including pancreatic cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, and colorectal cancer.
* Lead the strategy to elevate Revolution Medicines’ presence at major global scientific congresses, building a best-in-class congress model that expands our scientific visibility, stakeholder engagement, and impact as the company and portfolio grow.
* Drive development of strategic objectives, overall congress presence, scientific messaging, and engagement plans.
* Ensure high-quality, compliant execution of congress activities including medical booths, satellite events, and onsite pre-congress meetings.
* Lead Medical Affairs planning for global congresses in the U.S., EU, and APAC regions, ensuring global consistency with regional adaptation.
* Assess evolving needs and establish digital capabilities and processes to deliver timely, congress-specific scientific content to external stakeholders while ensuring appropriate governance and compliance across global markets.
* Evaluate and shape congress key performance indicators (KPIs) to optimize approach, priorities, and investments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner with Commercial, Clinical Development, and Research to ensure consistent communication and scientific engagement while maintaining appropriate governance and firewalls.
* Act as the central coordination point for cross-functional teams to align on congress priorities, deliverables, and messaging.
* Collaborate with Publications/Medical Communications to ensure alignment of abstracts, posters, oral presentations, and key data dissemination to other congress activities.

Operational Leadership & Governance

* Provide strategic direction and oversight to agency and vendor partners across congress activities, including booth development, ancillary events, internal meetings, and external stakeholder receptions, with accountability for budgets, timelines, operational excellence, and global and regional compliance.
* Ensure compliance with global and regional regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, PMDA, EFPIA, IFPMA).
* Establish best practices, SOPs, and governance processes for global congress planning.
* Capture and disseminate post-congress insights in collaboration with Medical Affairs Insights & Analytics and the broader Medical Affairs group.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* Advanced degree (MS, PharmD, PhD or equivalent in life sciences preferred but not required).
* 10+ years’ experience in Medical Affairs within the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry, preferably within a large, global pharmaceutical organization, with significant oncology experience and a strong background in congress strategy.
* Demonstrated experience leading congress strategy at scale within a global pharmaceutical or biotechnology organization, with a track record of building high-impact, integrated scientific congress presence across multiple functions, programs, and geographies.
* Strong understanding of oncology therapeutic landscape, particularly pancreatic cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, and colorectal cancer.
* Deep knowledge of compliance standards governing global congresses and scientific exchange.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional collaboration in a complex, matrixed environment.
* Excellent project management, organizational, and communication skills.
* Experience managing budgets, vendors, and operational processes related to congresses.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in early and late-phase development and product launch preparation in oncology.
* Understanding of global medical congress operations and digital engagement tools.
* Experience working in fast-paced, innovative, clinical-stage biotech organizations.

Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

As part of our expanding Medical Affairs organization, we seek a dynamic and experienced Director, Stakeholder Engagement Strategy & Operations to support the strategy, planning, and execution of global medical congress activitiesand elevate Revolution Medicines’ presence at major scientific congresses as our portfolio and organization grow. This individual will report to the Head of Scientific Stakeholder Engagement within Global Medical Excellence and will partner cross-functionally with Commercial, Clinical Development, and Research, providing leadership for global congress activities to ensure seamless integration of congress objectives with broader organizational priorities. Key responsibilities will include:

Congress Strategy & Execution

* Develop congress strategy for Medical Affairs with a focus on oncology therapeutic areas including pancreatic cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, and colorectal cancer.
* Lead the strategy to elevate Revolution Medicines’ presence at major global scientific congresses, building a best-in-class congress model that expands our scientific visibility, stakeholder engagement, and impact as the company and portfolio grow.
* Drive development of strategic objectives, overall congress presence, scientific messaging, and engagement plans.
* Ensure high-quality, compliant execution of congress activities including medical booths, satellite events, and onsite pre-congress meetings.
* Lead Medical Affairs planning for global congresses in the U.S., EU, and APAC regions, ensuring global consistency with regional adaptation.
* Assess evolving needs and establish digital capabilities and processes to deliver timely, congress-specific scientific content to external stakeholders while ensuring appropriate governance and compliance across global markets.
* Evaluate and shape congress key performance indicators (KPIs) to optimize approach, priorities, and investments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner with Commercial, Clinical Development, and Research to ensure consistent communication and scientific engagement while maintaining appropriate governance and firewalls.
* Act as the central coordination point for cross-functional teams to align on congress priorities, deliverables, and messaging.
* Collaborate with Publications/Medical Communications to ensure alignment of abstracts, posters, oral presentations, and key data dissemination to other congress activities.

Operational Leadership & Governance

* Provide strategic direction and oversight to agency and vendor partners across congress activities, including booth development, ancillary events, internal meetings, and external stakeholder receptions, with accountability for budgets, timelines, operational excellence, and global and regional compliance.
* Ensure compliance with global and regional regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, PMDA, EFPIA, IFPMA).
* Establish best practices, SOPs, and governance processes for global congress planning.
* Capture and disseminate post-congress insights in collaboration with Medical Affairs Insights & Analytics and the broader Medical Affairs group.
